findings: The public catalogue hierarchy names 8A217-2026 Culture and Education. The plan confirms both first years, the 12 EC Heritage Profession placement and a 30 EC minor. Article 2.5(d) in both unchanged adopted appendices names Digital Data and Digital Techniques among three methods prerequisites for the thesis. The exact cohort plan contains only the first two.
